description: Check a signed GBLIN authorization against the chain before spending gas on it. Recovers the signer from the EIP-712 digest (and asks the wallet itself through ERC-1271 when the payer is a contract), then checks the validity window against on-chain time, whether the nonce has already been used or cancelled, and whether the payer still holds the amount. Returns a verdict and the ready calldata when it would settle, the failing reason when it would not. This is the same set of checks an x402 facilitator runs, so a 'would_settle' verdict here means the payment is good to carry.

authorization.description: The authorization object: from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce.

method.description: Which method the signature was produced for. Default 'receive'.

signature.description: The signature produced by the payer's wallet, 0x-prefixed.

name: verify_gblin_authorization

failures.description: Reasons it would not settle; empty when it would.

submit.description: Calldata and who may submit it, or null when it would not settle.

would_settle.description: True only if the token would accept this authorization now.
